# Find the Difference.

@example The letters of garden plus an s, in a new order.
"garden"
"dangers"
=> "s"

@example t is plan with an i put in; nothing else has moved.
"plan"
"plain"
=> "i"

@example t has three l's and s only two: the extra letter is one that s already has.
"level"
"evlell"
=> "l"

# s is empty, so t's only letter is the extra one.
""
"q"
=> "q"

# One letter, then the same letter twice.
"a"
"aa"
=> "a"

# A run of z's, one longer.
"zzzz"
"zzzzz"
=> "z"

# t is s with the extra letter put in front, in the middle or at the end,
# and otherwise in the same order. A loop that stops at the length of s
# never looks at the last letter of t.
"ink"
"wink"
=> "w"

"pqrs"
"pqxrs"
=> "x"

"mnop"
"mnopz"
=> "z"

# t is shuffled: the first position where s and t differ holds an x in t,
# and x is not the extra letter.
"zyx"
"xazy"
=> "a"

# Every letter of t occurs in s, so only the counts tell: s has one b,
# t has two.
"abc"
"cbab"
=> "b"

# s has two n's, t has three.
"noon"
"onnon"
=> "n"

# The two ends of the alphabet.
"az"
"zaz"
=> "z"

"zz"
"zaz"
=> "a"

# All 26 letters, against all 26 backwards with a second m.
"abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
"zyxwvutsrqponmmlkjihgfedcba"
=> "m"

# Random small cases from gen.c (lc check --regen makes them).
@gen 1 small
"ccccbb"
"bbcccbc"
=> "b"

@gen 2 small
"zzxx"
"xzxxz"
=> "x"

@gen 3 small
"kc"
"cfk"
=> "f"

@gen 4 small
"aa"
"baa"
=> "b"

@gen 5 small
"a"
"za"
=> "z"

@gen 6 small
"z"
"za"
=> "a"

@gen 7 small
"zaaaaa"
"aaaaazz"
=> "z"

# Full size: s has 1000 letters. Seed 1: random letters, and t is s with
# the extra letter at its end. Seed 2: one letter throughout. Seed 3: a and
# b only, shuffled.
@gen 1
""
""
=> "a"

@gen 2
""
""
=> "z"

@gen 3
""
""
=> "b"
